title: Not safe, falling apart
text:
Not safe, falling apart. I wanted to love this mirror. I had fallen in love with it before it arrived, prepped the perfect place for it in our new entry. I was excited.

When we opened it, three of the screws that hold it together were loose in the box. Unfortunately, the holes the screw into in the MDF were bored out and they could no longer find purchase and keep the mirror together. The mirror itself is nice but there’s large sections where the black and worn off. This can look decorative if done right, here it just looks like it’s made from cheap material.

My husband tried to use the old “toothpick” trick to fix the bored out holes but it didn’t work. There’s no way we can hang this with any level of safety or confidence. We have a toddler in the house and I can’t risk this thing falling apart and hitting her. We will try one more fix with super glue but I’m not terribly optimistic.

I would have contacted them directly but there were no details or info in the box like many companies do. Reading other reviews, I am disappointed that this is not an isolated experience.

Wanted to love this so badly but it is simply not worth the price for a mirror that cannot be reliably hung.
